catalogue: 28 historical narrative scenarios, restored from Git; never the current 720-scene catalogue.
runtimeFingerprint: SHA256 of sorted astronomy/, data/, game/ relative paths and file SHA256s, each encoded path + NUL + hash + newline.

policySemantics.roster: full; lifetime encounter count fixed at 32
policySemantics.route: Prefer arm node kind, then shortest path to exit; independent difficulty_route tie stream, including single-candidate draws.
policySemantics.combat: Immediate historical survival or exact two-turn expectation, allowance 0; enumerate next announcements without reading future live RNG.
policySemantics.entryAware: Lethality sensitivity only: resolved leaves analytically value another Self Necessity sweep before recovery, except after full combustion or completed map 7; this is not optimal play.

fortune.description: Final Fortune comparison; first 20 charts and 5 runs of the lethality cohort, not an independent sample.

half.rules: Self and Other uniform [12,24,36] at combat entry, lethal clamp, Fortune halves; map resurrection only.

block.rules: Same lethal entry, but Fortune blocks the full draw and retains zero-amount entries. Historical halved metadata marks Fortune success.

lethality.description: Primary capped versus lethal comparison; fourth arm is a separate predeclared continuation sensitivity.

capped-36.rules: Self and Other uniform [24,36,48] at combat entry, cap at Resolve minus 1; Fortune halves; map resurrection only.

lethal-24.rules: Self and Other uniform [12,24,36] at combat entry, cap at Resolve; Fortune halves; map resurrection only. Full entry wipe resolves at turn 0 without Light.

necessity.description: Asymmetric versus symmetric confirmation; both use Self [24,36,48].

self-36-other-24.rules: Self uniform [24,36,48], Other [12,24,36] at combat entry; cap at Resolve minus 1; Fortune halves; map resurrection only.

self-36-other-36.rules: Both sides uniform [24,36,48] at combat entry; cap at Resolve minus 1; Fortune halves; map resurrection only.

basic.description: Original tuning screen: unchanged rules, extra player Necessity, and doubled player-side combat affliction.

baseline.rules: Original player map Necessity plus Other combat-entry Necessity, uniform [12,24,36], cap at Resolve minus 1, Fortune halves.

extra-player-necessity.rules: Retain original map Necessity and add player combat-entry Necessity using effective chart and encounter roster. No extra revival; original Other entry unchanged.

double-player-damage.rules: Double only raw positive player-side combat affliction before clamps, direct or propagated, including inverted Testimony. Preserve healing magnitudes, Other damage, probability, Necessity and narrative.
